verdict.rationale: Speechmatics exposes its core functions through APIs: batch and realtime transcription, text to speech, and job deletion. Workspace administration is also programmatic, since admin tokens can create projects and manage API keys. However, the web platform also covers billing and voice-agent building, and there is no documented statement that the API matches the UI. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for billing and the web platform's agent builder, clear API coverage for user invites and role management, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
